prompt: Our turn-based strategy game collapses repeated identical moves in the replay viewer by comparing move signatures as plain strings. A player reported the same move showing up twice in a replay: the battle simulator and the input recorder assemble a move's modifier group in different sequences, and moveSignature in src/turn-ids.mjs emits a different string for each, so the replay viewer treats them as two distinct moves. Run npm test to confirm the failing regression before fixing; it should pass once the fix is in.
